ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
UpdateContext({varUserToEdit:ThisItem});
Patch(
    DeskAccessControl,
    varUserToEdit,
    {
        AccessLevel_Choice: { Value: varUserToEdit.AccessLevel_Choice.Value },
        AccessLevel_Text: Text(varUserToEdit.AccessLevel_Choice.Value),
        AboutMe_Text: "AccessLevel renewed at level '" & varUserToEdit.AccessLevel_Choice.Value & "', by '" & User().Email & "', modified on '" & Now() & "';",
        AccessStart_dateTime: Now(),
        AccessStop_dateTime: DateAdd(Now(), 180, TimeUnit.Days),
        modificationAutoTriggered_Choice: { Value: "false" },
        AccessReviewOverdue_Choice: { Value: "false" },
        NetworkAccount_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).mailNickname,
        Email_Person: varUserToEdit.Email_Person,
        AccessStart_Text: Text(Now()),
        AccessStop_Text: Text(DateAdd(Now(), 180, TimeUnit.Days)),
        'addMinutes(utcNow(),10)': DateAdd(Now(),10,TimeUnit.Minutes),
        Approver_DisplayName_Text: Office365Users.MyProfileV2().displayName,
        Approver_Email_Text: User().Email,
        Department_Text : Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).department,
        DisplayName_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).displayName,
        Email_Text: Lower(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).userPrincipalName),
        FullAddress_Text:
            Concatenate(
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).department, ", ",
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).companyName, ", ",
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).streetAddress, ", ",
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).city, ", ",
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).state, ", ",
                Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).postalCode
            ),
        GivenName_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).givenName,
        HireDate_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).hireDate,
        ID: varUserToEdit.ID,
        MailNickname_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).mailNickname,
        Manager_Email_Text: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).mail,
        Manager_DisplayName_Text: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).displayName,
        Manager_Email_Person:
            {
                '@odata.type': "#Microsoft.Azure.Connectors.SharePoint.SPListExpandedUser",
                Claims:  "i:0#.f|membership|" & Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).displayName,
                Department: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).department,
                DisplayName: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).displayName,
                Email: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).userPrincipalName,
                JobTitle: Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).jobTitle,
                Picture: Office365Users.UserPhotoV2(Office365Users.ManagerV2(Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id).id)
            },
        Approver_Email_Person:
            {
                '@odata.type': "#Microsoft.Azure.Connectors.SharePoint.SPListExpandedUser",
                Claims: "i:0#.f|membership|" & Office365Users.MyProfileV2().displayName,
                Department: Office365Users.MyProfileV2().department,
                Picture: User().Image,
                DisplayName: Office365Users.MyProfileV2().displayName,
                Email: Office365Users.MyProfileV2().userPrincipalName,
                JobTitle: Office365Users.MyProfileV2().jobTitle
            }
    }
);
Patch(
    DeskAccessControl,
    varUserToEdit,
    {
        Id_Text: Office365Users.UserProfileV2(varUserToEdit.Id_Text).id
    }
);
UpdateContext({varShowConfirmEdit:false});
Reset(Dropdown4);
UpdateContext({varUserToEdit: Blank()});
Refresh(DeskAccessControl);
ClearCollect(colDeskAccess, DeskAccessControl);

SortByColumns(
    Filter(
        Desks,
       Active_boolean = true || Active_text = "true"
    ),
    "Title",
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

If(
    IsBlankOrError(var_PopUp_AddNewUser),
        Set(var_PopUp_AddNewUser, true),
    !IsBlankOrError(var_PopUp_AddNewUser),
        Set(var_PopUp_AddNewUser, true)
)
